dcterms:creator: Maja Popović
dcterms:description: This dataset was created for purposes of MT evaluation and consists of English user reviews translated into Croatian and Serbian. It includes outputs from ten different MT systems, with errors highlighted based on adequacy and comprehension criteria.
dcterms:title: DCU dataset

dcterms:creator: J. Kreutzer
dcterms:description: This dataset consists of English TED talks translated into German by one MT system. It was created to improve an NMT system by providing feedback about errors, with no specific quality criterion used for error highlighting.
dcterms:title: HU dataset
